purpose: Identify publicly available Yu-Gi-Oh! binder/collection and pack-opening footage as inputs for automatic teacher/OCR/catalog label proposals. No video or frame has been downloaded or labeled.
resolution_policy: Source resolution must be verified from actual video metadata before eligibility. Title, thumbnail, or creator claims alone do not verify resolution. Every current entry is resolution-unknown and ineligible until verified; no card-crop quality is claimed.
labeling_policy: OCR over card text regions is the first stage (PaddleOCR is a candidate). Extract only ID-like strings visibly present in pixels, syntax-check, and query the catalog. Never invent, autocomplete, or infer missing code characters. Visual retrieval is fallback when no valid OCR ID exists, disambiguation for multiple catalog hits, or opt-in. Conflicting or weak cases become unresolved/quarantined automatically; no user screening or labeling is required. Proposals are not verified ground truth.
